def range_compress(input_list):
    if not input_list:
        return []
    unique = sorted(set(input_list))
    result = []
    start = unique[0]
    prev = start
    for val in unique[1:]:
        if val == prev + 1:
            prev = val
        else:
            result.append([start, prev])
            start = val
            prev = val
    result.append([start, prev])
    return result

def range_compress(nums):
    distinct = sorted(set(nums))
    result = []
    i = 0
    n = len(distinct)
    while i < n:
        start = distinct[i]
        j = i + 1
        while j < n and distinct[j] == distinct[j - 1] + 1:
            j += 1
        end = distinct[j - 1]
        if j - i > 1:
            result.append([start, end])
        else:
            result.append([start, start])
        i = j
    return result
